note: Election of councillors for Newtownards Borough Council, 17 May 1961. There was no poll: all four wards were returned unopposed. Glen Ward had four nominations, but the Rev. Albert H. M'Elroy withdrew, leaving the three sitting members (Northern Whig, 5 May 1961, p. 8) (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). The Rev. A. H. M'Elroy withdrew his nomination; the Whig says the Acts were understood to prohibit a minister of a church from being a member of a local authority. Returned unopposed.
